content: GNOME Control Center (gnome-settings) panels: Wi-Fi/Network incl. VPN+proxy via NetworkManager front-ends, Bluetooth, Sound (device select), Power (battery + performance/balanced/power-saver via power-profiles-daemon), Displays (resolution/scale/refresh/arrange/night-light), Keyboard (shortcuts+layouts), Mouse & Touchpad, Users, Date & Time, Region & Language, Online Accounts, Privacy, Accessibility, Default Apps, About (RAM/CPU/GPU/disk/hostname). Verified against help.gnome.org + component docs.
